facts.raw_span: A man in his 40s with a medical history of factor VII deficiency hemophilia
presented with acute hypoxic respiratory failure
Staphylococcus hemolyticus bacteremia
erythema and edematous necrotic plaques of the bilateral ears
No devices had been used on the ears
Erythematous plaque (2 cm) with overlying eschar on the right earlobe
Multiple erythematous edematous erosions with eschar and crust on the helical rim of the left ear
Detached epidermis with full-thickness necrosis overlying sparse inflammation associated with necrosis of adnexal epithelia, including folliculosebaceous units and eccrine glands
Epidermal and dermal necrosis and ulceration with necrosis of the eccrine glands
intubated with prone positioning, and treatment was initiated
The necrosis progressed during the following days, primarily involving the earlobe of the right ear and a large portion of the helix of the left ear
